guest_list.description: Every Proxmox VM and container on the hypervisor: vmid, name, kind, running or stopped, max memory. From Prometheus, so up to ~15 s old.

host.description: Host name as Prometheus labels it, e.g. pve1

host_health.description: CPU busy %, memory and root-disk space for one host, from Prometheus node metrics.

jellyfin_library_counts.description: How many movies, series, episodes, songs, albums etc. are in Jellyfin.

jellyfin_library_scan.description: Start a Jellyfin library scan (picks up new or removed media). Never runs straight away: it posts a request to the approver in Discord and returns a request id; it runs only if the approver approves within 30 minutes. Check with request_status.

jellyfin_sessions.description: Who is on Jellyfin in the last 16 minutes: user, app, device name, and what is playing (paused or not). IPs and device ids are dropped.

pve_guest_power.description: Start, shut down (clean ACPI shutdown) or reboot one Proxmox guest. Never runs straight away: it posts a request to the approver in Discord and returns a request id; it runs only if the approver approves within 30 minutes. Check with request_status. Only allowlisted guests; the workstation, secrets vault, agent host and the switchboard never are.

pve_node_status.description: The Proxmox host right now: uptime, CPU busy %, load, memory, swap, root disk, Proxmox and kernel versions. Live from the Proxmox API.

pve_recent_tasks.description: The Proxmox host's most recent tasks, newest first: type, guest id, user, status, start and end time (unix seconds). Backups, VM starts, apt updates.

id.description: The request id an approve tool returned, e.g. r-0123456789ab

request_status.description: Status of one of your approval requests: pending, executed, failed, denied or expired, with the result once it ran.

services_up.description: Every target Prometheus scrapes, with up or down. A quick view of what is broken.
